# Porto, 6 to 12 April 2026

Trip dates 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12. Bolt works everywhere, cards accepted almost everywhere.

## Dinner

- **Cantina 32** – Industrial room off Rua das Flores, small plates and a famously good chocolate cake. About €35 a head. 12:30-15:00, 19:30-23:00, closed Sunday. 4.5 stars (3,102 reviews). [Map](https://maps.google.com/?cid=1234)
- **Genuino** – Chef-led tasting menu near Bolsa. €55. Booked for 2026-04-08. [Map](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xyz) [Site](https://genuino.pt)

### Backups

- **Tasquinha do Bairro** – Neighbourhood tasca, no bookings, cash only.
- **Adega Sao Nicolau** – Riverside, tourist-heavy but the grilled fish is real. ★ 4.2

## Coffee

- **Combi Coffee** – The best espresso in the city, opens 08:30. €2.50. https://combicoffee.pt
  - Take the window seat, the back room is loud.
  - Closed Mondays.
- **7g Roaster** – Second-wave big brother, roasts on site, 08:00-19:00 daily.

## Practical notes

- **Metro to the airport** – Line E, 40 minutes, buy the Andante card at the machine.
- **Tipping** – Round up, nothing more is expected.
